data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for UserX session recording and UX analytics with sensitive content masking.
data.what_it_does: Provides APIs to start UserX session recording, configure rendering, and mask sensitive widgets via OccludeWrapper. Captures UI interactions on iOS and Android, including support for TextureView rendering on Android.
use_when: You need built‑in session recording and UX analytics for a Flutter app
You must mask sensitive UI elements like credit‑card fields
You target iOS 15+ and Android API 21+
avoid_when: You require a cross‑platform analytics solution not tied to UserX
You need support for web or desktop platforms
Your iOS deployment target is below 15
strengths: Simple API with just a few method calls
Handles background screenshot capture on iOS
weaknesses: iOS minimum version 15 limits older devices
Only works with the UserX backend
Requires native SDK update via pod install
data.setup_notes: Add userx_flutter to pubspec, run `flutter pub get`, then execute `pod install --repo-update` and set iOS deployment target to 15.0 in Podfile and Xcode project.
